title: Grateful Dead Live at Rhode Island Auditorium on 1971-04-21
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > 1st generation reels > 2nd generation reels > PCM (Sony HG tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1971 show with a scorching Hard to Handle and solid mix of old & new material, captured on clear audience tape.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this April 1971 performance, calling it one of the band’s hottest shows of the year with standout renditions of Hard to Handle, The Other One, Wharf Rat and Uncle John’s Band. The audience‑sourced recording is praised for its vivid presence and lack of noticeable flaws, making it a top‑tier listen for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are strongly positive (4–5 stars) and consistently highlight both an exceptional performance and a clean audience recording, leading to a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the tape as "nuts" and great for headphones‑to‑headphones listening; no major dropouts or muffling reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A balanced blend of classic jams and fresh 1971 material keeps the momentum high throughout an intimate venue setting.
